problemStatement: Current Shadow cohorts systematically omit early Formal liquidity rejections, so the opportunity-cost and protection value of the liquidity gate cannot be falsified with existing cohort comparisons.

lowAverageVolumeException.condition: avgAmount20>=50000000 AND spreadPercent is observed <=0.5 AND (orderBookDepthGood===true OR depthScore>=80)
lowAverageVolumeException.upstreamRepositoryStatus: NO_REPOSITORY_CONSTRUCTION_FOUND; arbitrary external enrichment fields can flow through mergeEnrichment/buildMarketFeatures, so Production coverage remains UNKNOWN rather than proven absent.

smallCap10to30Yi.rejectionReason: 10至30億市值缺少強力特殊理由

existingShadowGap.BROAD_CONTROL: Requires avgVolume20Lots>=minLots, so it excludes low-liquidity names by construction.
existingShadowGap.REJECTED_AFTER_BASE: Requires result.basePassed===true, but all three liquidity-admission rejection reasons return basePassed=false.
existingShadowGap.conclusion: No existing standard Shadow cohort is an honest control for the early liquidity gate.

proposedCohorts.interpretation: Failed primary average-volume threshold and did not prove the existing amount/spread/depth exception.

proposedCohorts.exactReason: 10至30億市值缺少強力特殊理由
proposedCohorts.interpretation: Passed/excepted initial volume gate but failed stricter small-cap liquidity+institutional exception.
Failed the stricter 1.2x volume requirement for sub-100bn market cap without an accepted liquidity exception.
Below primary minLots but passed the existing avgAmount/spread/depth exception; descriptive positive control only.

minimumReceiptFields: A/B technical checks computed descriptively only after the rejection for research; fullFormalCounterfactual=false

sampling.primary: Deterministic bounded sample per exact reject reason and price pool, plus total reject counts by reason.
sampling.preferredFuture: If storage budget permits, retain the full early-liquidity-rejected population because gate prevalence can be large; otherwise report sampling fraction and never infer whole-universe opportunity loss from bounded rows.

outcomes: where point-in-time executable evidence exists: spread/slippage/depth state
falsification: If rejected names have worse or no better opportunity paths after controls and/or materially worse executable-liquidity evidence, retain the gate.
If apparently attractive rejected names disappear after costs/slippage/depth controls, reject gate relaxation.

If a large, stable subset of rejected names has acceptable executable liquidity and superior MFE/return without worse MAE/stop/no-follow-through across independent dates/OOS, a gate reformulation may become a future Class-C optimization candidate.
Do not threshold-sweep 1000/300/1.2x/1.5x after seeing outcomes.
Do not interpret missing spread/depth as good liquidity.
Do not call a rejected row 'would have qualified otherwise'; later Formal gates remain unknown.

engineeringBoundary.dailyRejectedCohortCapture: Potential Class A if it only serializes already-computed featureRows/results to isolated research storage with zero new market calls and Formal invariants unchanged.
engineeringBoundary.spreadDepthSourceRepair: Class B proposal-first if proving/filling spread/depth requires shared enrichment, new market-data calls, monitoring, or shared runtime/schema changes.

optimizationBridge.promotionPrerequisite: Prospective rejected-control evidence must prove opportunity loss after execution-cost/liquidity controls, independent dates, regimes, price tiers and OOS, with no material downside or zero-pick degradation.
